meta.title: Metaphysics Charts
meta.description: Six systems in one plugin: BaZi (hidden stems, ten gods, 12 stages, 42 shensha, strength, pattern and useful-god, luck scoring), Zi Wei Dou Shu (49 stars with brightness, four 12-god cycles, 34 patterns, decade and annual/monthly/daily/hourly mutagen), LiuYao, MeiHua YiShu, Da Liu Ren and Tarot, plus an ask-driven interpretation layer. Computed locally and exposed as an agent tool with a Web panel.
